G1247.def:
**διακονέω**, ῶ
(δίακονος);
1. generally, **to minister, serre, wait upon**, especially at table, **to do one a service, cure for one's needs**: absol., [[Mat.20.28|Mat.20:28]], [[Mrk.10.45|Mrk.10:45]], [[Luk.10.40; 22.26, 27|Luk.10:40 22:26, 27]], [[Jhn.12.2|Jhn.12:2]], [[1Pe.4.11|1Pe.4:11]]; ὅσα διηκόνησεν, [[2Ti.1.18|2Ti.1:18]] with dative of person(s), [[Mat.4.11; 8.15; 25.44; 27.55|Mat.4:11 8:15 25:44 27:55]], [[Mrk.1.13, 31; 15.41|Mrk.1:13, 31 15:41]], [[Luk.4.39; 8.3; 12.37; 17.8|Luk.4:39 8:3 12:37 17:8]], [[Jhn.12.26|Jhn.12:26]], [[Act.6.2; 19.22|Act.6:2 19:22]], [[Rom.15.25|Rom.15:25]], Phm 13, [[Heb.6.10|Heb.6:10]].
2. **to serve as deacon**: [[1Ti.3.10; 3.13|1Ti.3:10, 3:13]].
3. C. accusative of thing(s), **to minister, supply, supply by ministration**: [[1Pe.1.12; 4.10|1Pe.1:12 4:10]]; pass., [[2Co.3.3; 8.19, 20|2Co.3:3 8:19, 20]].†
_SYN._: λειτουργέω, which see (Cremer, 179). (AS)

G1205.def:
**δεῦτε **
_adv._, as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see, [in LXX chiefly for לְכוּ ;]
**come on! come here! come!**: with imperat., [[Mat.25.34; 28.6|Mat.25:34 28:6]], [[Jhn.4.29; 21.12|Jhn.4:29 21:12]], [[Rev.19.17|Rev.19:17]]; with subjc., [[Mat.21.38|Mat.21:38]], [[Mrk.12.7|Mrk.12:7]]; before ὀπίσω, [[Mat.4.19|Mat.4:19]], [[Mrk.1.17|Mrk.1:17]]; πρός, [[Mat.11.28|Mat.11:28]] εἰς, [[Mat.22.4|Mat.22:4]], [[Mrk.6.31|Mrk.6:31]].†
(AS)

G1259.def:
**δι-αλλάσσω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.29.4|1Ki.29:4]] (רָצָה hithp.), I [[Est.4.31|Est.4:31]], al. ;]
1. **to change, exchange**.
2. **to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile**: pass., with dative of person(s), [[Mat.5.24|Mat.5:24]] "The word denotes mutual concession after mutual hostility, an idea absent from καταλλ-," which see (Lft., _Notes_, 288; cf. Deiss., _LAE_, 178.15; Cremer, 91, 632).†
(AS)

G1227.def:
**δια-βλέπω **
1. **to took straight before one**.
2. **to see clearly**: [[Mat.7.5|Mat.7:5]], [[Mrk.8.25|Mrk.8:25]], [[Luk.6.42|Luk.6:42]] (cf. διάβλεψις, Aq., [[Isa.61.1|Isa.61:1]], for LXX ἀνάβ-).†
(AS)

G1209.def:
**δέχομαι**, depon. mid.,
[in LXX chiefly for לקח ;]
**to receive, accept**;
1. with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, [[Luk.16.6|Luk.16:6]], 7; id. in different sense, [[Act.28.21|Act.28:21]] ποτήριον, [[Luk.22.17|Luk.22:17]] παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), [[Luk.2.28|Luk.2:28]] περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, [[Eph.6.17|Eph.6:17]] ἐπιστολάς, [[Act.22.5|Act.22:5]] τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, [[Mrk.10.15|Mrk.10:15]], [[Luk.18.17|Luk.18:17]]; λογία ζῶντα, [[Act.7.38|Act.7:38]] εὐαγγέλιον, [[2Co.11.4|2Co.11:4]] τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, [[2Co.6.1|2Co.6:1]] metaphorically, of mental acceptance, [[Mat.11.14|Mat.11:14]] τ. λόγον, [[Luk.8.13|Luk.8:13]], [[Act.8.14; 11.1; 17.11|Act.8:14 11:1 17:11]], [[1Th.1.6; 2.13|1Th.1:6 2:13]], [[Jas.1.21|Jas.1:21]]; τὰ τ. πνεύματος, [[1Co.2.14|1Co.2:14]] τ. παράκλησιν, [[2Co.8.17|2Co.8:17]] τ. ἀγάπην τ. ἀληθείας, [[2Th.2.10|2Th.2:10]]
2. with accusative of person(s), of receiving kindly or hospitably, [[Mat.10.14, 40, 41|Mat.10:14 40, 41]], [[Mrk.6.11|Mrk.6:11]], [[Luk.9.5, 53; 10.8, 10|Luk.9:5 53 10:8, 10]], [[Jhn.4.45|Jhn.4:45]], [[2Co.7.15; 11.16|2Co.7:15 11:16]], [[Gal.4.14|Gal.4:14]], [[Col.4.10|Col.4:10]], [[Heb.11.31|Heb.11:31]]; παιδίον, [[Mat.18.5|Mat.18:5]], [[Mrk.9.37|Mrk.9:37]], [[Luk.9.48|Luk.9:48]]; εἰς οἴκους, σκηνάς, [[Luk.16.4|Luk.16:4]], 9; δέξαι τ. πνεῦμά μου, [[Act.7.59|Act.7:59]] ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν δέασθαι, [[Act.3.21|Act.3:21]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο, δια-, εἰσ-, ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-, ὑπο-δέχομαι; Cremer, 174).†
(AS)

G1299.def:
**δια-τάσσω **
[in LXX for שׂוּם, שָׁמַר, etc. ;]
**to charge, give orders to, appoint, arrange, ordain**: with dative, [[Mat.11.1|Mat.11:1]], [[1Co.9.14; 16.1|1Co.9:14 16:1]]; before inf., [[Luk.8.55|Luk.8:55]], [[Act.18.2|Act.18:2]]. Mid., [[1Co.7.17|1Co.7:17]], [[Act.20.13|Act.20:13]]; with accusative, [[1Co.11.34|1Co.11:34]] with dative, [[Tit.1.5|Tit.1:5]] before inf., [[Act.7.44; 24.23|Act.7:44 24:23]]. Pass., τὸ διατεταγμένον, [[Luk.3.13|Luk.3:13]], [[Act.23.31|Act.23:31]]; τὰ διαταχθέντα, [[Luk.17.9-10;|Luk.17:9-10]] διαταγείς, [[Gal.3.19|Gal.3:19]]†
(AS)

G1201.def:
**δεσμωτήριον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX for בֵּית סֹהַר (Ge), אָסִיר ;]
**a prison**: [[Mat.11.2|Mat.11:2]], [[Act.5.21, 23; 16.26|Act.5:21, 23 16:26]].†
(AS)

G1210.def:
**δέω** (I),
[in LXX chiefly for אסר ;]
**to tie, bind, fasten**;
(1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, [[Mat.13.30|Mat.13:30]] of an ass, [[Mat.21.2|Mat.21:2]], [[Mrk.11.2|Mrk.11:2]], 4 [[Luk.19.30|Luk.19:30]].
(2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, [[Jhn.19.40|Jhn.19:40]] δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), [[Jhn.11.44|Jhn.11:44]] of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, [[Rev.9.14|Rev.9:14]] a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, [[Mrk.5.3|Mrk.5:3]], 4; captives, [[Mat.12.29; 14.3; 22.13; 27.2|Mat.12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2]], [[Mrk.3.27; 6.17; 15.1, 7|Mrk.3:27 6:17 15:1, 7]], [[Jhn.18.12, 24|Jhn.18:12, 24]], [[Act.9.2, 14, 21; 21.11, 13; 22.5, 29; 24.27|Act.9:2, 14, 21, 21:11, 13 22:5, 29 24:27]], [[Col.4.3|Col.4:3]], [[Rev.20.2|Rev.20:2]]; ἁλύσεσι, [[Act.12.6; 21.33|Act.12:6 21:33]]. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, [[2Ti.2.9|2Ti.2:9]] of Satan binding by disease (MM, see word), [[Luk.13.16|Luk.13:16]] of constraint or obligation, [[Act.20.22|Act.20:22]] of the marriage bond, [[1Co.7.39|1Co.7:39]] id. with dative of person(s), ἀνδρί, [[Rom.7.2|Rom.7:2]] γυναικί, [[1Co.7.27|1Co.7:27]] in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, _Words_, 213f.), **to forbid, declare forbidden**, [[Mat.16.19; 18.18|Mat.16:19 18:18]] (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82).
† (AS)

G1283.def:
**δι-αρπάζω **
[in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc. ;]
**to plunder**: [[Mat.12.29|Mat.12:29]], [[Mrk.3.27|Mrk.3:27]].†
(AS)

G1211.def:
**δή **
consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as **now therefore, then, verily, certainly**.
1. **With verbs**: imperat., [[Act.6.3|Act.6:3]] (WH, mg.) 13:2, [[1Co.6.20|1Co.6:20]]; hort. subjc., [[Luk.2.15|Luk.2:15]], [[Act.15.36|Act.15:36]]; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), [[Heb.2.16|Heb.2:16]]
2. **With pronouns**: ὃ δή, **now this is he who**, [[Mat.13.23|Mat.13:23]]†
(AS)

G1285.def:
**δια-σαφέω**, -ῶ
(σαφής, _clear_), [in LXX: [[Deu.1.5|Deu.1:5]] (בָּאַר pi.), Dan LXX 2:6 (חָוָה aphel.), I-III Ma 9 * ;]
**to make clear, explain fully**: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), [[Mat.13.26; 18.31|Mat.13:26 18:31]].†
(AS)

G1295.def:
**δια-σώζω **
[in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע, etc. ;]
**to bring safely through a danger**: [[Luk.7.3|Luk.7:3]], [[Act.27.43|Act.27:43]]; before πρός, [[Act.23.24|Act.23:24]] Pass., **to come safe through**: [[Act.28.1|Act.28:1]] ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, [[Act.27.44|Act.27:44]] ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, [[Act.28.4|Act.28:4]] δι᾽ ὕδατος, [[1Pe.3.20|1Pe.3:20]] of sickness, **to recover**: [[Mat.14.36|Mat.14:36]]†
(AS)

G1261.def:
**δια-λογισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαλογίζομαι) [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲשָׁבָה ;]
**a thought, reasoning, inward questioning**: [[Mat.15.19|Mat.15:19]], [[Mrk.7.21|Mrk.7:21]], [[Luk.2.35; 5.22; 6.8; 9.46, 47; 24.38|Luk.2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38]], [[Rom.1.21; 14.1|Rom.1:21 14:1]], [[1Co.3.20|1Co.3:20]]" (LXX), [[Php.2.14|Php.2:14]] κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. [[Pro.12.5|Pro.12:5]]), [[Jas.2.4|Jas.2:4]]; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in [[Psa.139.20|Ps 138(139):20]], al., implies evil intention), [[1Ti.2.8|1Ti.2:8]] (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).†
(AS)

G1252.def:
**δια-κρίνω **
[in LXX for שׁפט, דִּין, etc. ;]
1. **to separate**, hence, **to distinguish, discriminate, discern**: μηδὲν δ., [[Act.11.12|Act.11:12]] οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, [[Act.15.9|Act.15:9]] σε, [[1Co.4.7|1Co.4:7]] τὸ σῶμα, [[1Co.11.29|1Co.11:29]]
2. **to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate**: [[Mat.16.3|Mat.16:3]], [[1Co.6.5; 11.29|1Co.6:5 11:29]] (_ICC_, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Mid, and pass.;
1. **to get a decision, contend, dispute**: before πρός, [[Act.11.2|Act.11:2]] with dative (but see _ICC_, in l.), [[Jude.9|Ju 9]]; absol., [[Jude.22|Ju 22]] (R,mg.).
2. Hellenistic (NT and Eccl., but not LXX), **to be divided in one's mind, to hesitate, doubt**: [[Mat.21.21|Mat.21:21]] [[Rom.14.23|Rom.14:23]], [[Jas.1.6|Jas.1:6]]; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, [[Jas.2.4|Jas.2:4]] ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[Mrk.11.23|Mrk.11:23]] μηδὲν δ., [[Act.10.20|Act.10:20]] δ. τ. ἀπιστίᾳ, [[Rom.4.20|Rom.4:20]], [[Jude.22|Ju 22]] (R, txt.).†
(AS)

G1260.def:
**δια-λογίζομαι**, depon.
[in LXX chiefly for חשׁב, frequently in Pss. ;]
1. **to balance accounts** (Dem.).
2. **to consider, reason** (Isocr.): [[Luk.1.29; 5.21|Luk.1:29 5:21]]; ἐν τ. καρδία, [[Mrk.2.6|Mrk.2:6]], 8, [[Luk.5.22|Luk.5:22]]; περί [[Luk.3.15|Luk.3:15]] ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), [[Mat.16.7-8|Mat.16:7-8]], [[Mrk.2.8|Mrk.2:8]], [[Luk.12.17|Luk.12:17]]; πρὸς ἑ., [[Mrk.9.33; 11.31|Mrk.9:33 11:31]], [[Luk.20.14|Luk.20:14]]; παρ᾽ ἑ., [[Mat.21.25|Mat.21:25]] (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[Mrk.8.16|Mrk.8:16]] ὅτι, [[Mrk.8.17|Mrk.8:17]], [[Jhn.11.50|Jhn.11:50]], Rec. (_DB_, i, 611; Cremer, 400).†
(AS)

G1291.def:
**δια-στελλω **
[in LXX for בָּדַל hi. ([[Deu.10.8|Deu.10:8]], al.), זְהַר hi. ([[Ezk.3.18-19|Eze.3:18-19]], al.), and 19 other words]
1. **to divide, distinguish, define**.
2. **to command, charge expressly**: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, [[Heb.12.20|Heb.12:20]] Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), [[Mrk.8.15|Mrk.8:15]], [[Act.15.24|Act.15:24]]; before ἵνα, [[Mat.16.20|Mat.16:20]], [[Mrk.5.43; 7.36; 9.9|Mrk.5:43 7:36 9:9]].†
(AS)

G1294.def:
**δια-στρέφω **
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, עָקַשׁ, etc. ;]
**to distort, twist**; metaphorically, **to distort, pervert**: [[Luk.23.2|Luk.23:2]], [[Act.13.8, 10|Act.13:8, 10]]; διεστραμμένος, **perverse**: [[Mat.17.17|Mat.17:17]], [[Luk.9.41|Luk.9:41]], [[Act.20.30|Act.20:30]], [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]].†
(AS)

G1204.def:
**δεῦρο **
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for לֵךְ, לֵכָה ;]
1. **of place**;
(a) **hither**, with verbs of motion;
(b) (in cl. chiefly poët.) as an imperat., **here! come!**: [[Mat.19.21|Mat.19:21]], [[Mrk.10.21|Mrk.10:21]], [[Luk.18.22|Luk.18:22]], [[Jhn.11.43|Jhn.11:43]], [[Act.7.3|Act.7:3]]" (LXX) , 34 (LXX), [[Rev.17.1; 21.9|Rev.17:1 21:9]].
2. Of time, **hitherto, now**: [[Rev.1.13|Rev.1:13]]†
(AS)

G1249.def:
**διάκονος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(derivation unknown), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: [[Est.6.3|Est.6:3]], 5, א B [[Est.1.10; 2.2|Est.1:10 2:2]], [[Pro.10.4|Pro.10:4]], [[4Ma.9.17|4Ma.9:17]] * ;]
1. in general, **a servant, attendant, minister**: [[Mat.20.26; 22.13; 23.11|Mat.20:26 22:13 23:11]], [[Mrk.9.35; 10.43|Mrk.9:35 10:43]], [[Jhn.2.5|Jhn.2:5]], 9, [[1Co.3.5|1Co.3:5]], [[Gal.2.17|Gal.2:17]], [[Eph.6.21|Eph.6:21]], [[Col.4.7|Col.4:7]]; δ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.13.4|Rom.13:4]], [[2Co.6.4|2Co.6:4]], [[1Th.3.2|1Th.3:2]]; δ. Χριστοῦ, [[2Co.11.23|2Co.11:23]], [[Col.1.7|Col.1:7]], [[1Ti.4.6|1Ti.4:6]]; cf. ὁ δ. ὁ ἐμός, [[Jhn.12.26|Jhn.12:26]] δ. περιτομῆς, [[Rom.15.8|Rom.15:8]] δ. καινῆς διαθήκης, [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]] δ. δικαιοσύνης, [[2Co.11.15|2Co.11:15]] δ. [εὐαγγελίου], [[Eph.3.7|Eph.3:7]], [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]]; δ. [ἐκκλησίας], [[Col.1.25|Col.1:25]]
2. As technical term for Church officer (so in pre-Christian times, see M, _Th._, I, 32), **a deacon**: [[Php.1.1|Php.1:1]], [[1Ti.3.8, 12|1Ti.3:8, 12]]; fem. (cf. Eccl. διακονίσσα), [[Rom.16.1|Rom.16:1]] (cf. [[1Ti.3.11|1Ti.3:11]], and CGT, in l., also M, _Th._, l.with).†
_SYN._: δοῦλος, _bondman_; θεράπων, _servant_ acting voluntarily; ὑπηρέτης, _servant, attendant_, by etymol. suggesting subordination. All these imply relation to a person, in distinction from which δ. represents rather the servant in relation to his work. Cf. also λειτουργός, _a public servant_, in which the idea of service to the community is prominent; οἰκέτης, _a house servant_. (AS)

G1208.def:
**δεῦτερος**, -α, -ον,
**second** in order, with or without idea of time: [[Mat.22.26, 39|Mat.22:26, 39]], al.; θάνατος, [[Rev.2.11; 20.14; 21.8|Rev.2:11 20:14 21:8]]; χάρις, [[2Co.1.15|2Co.1:15]] In neut. as adv., **secondly, a second time**; opposite to πρῶτον: [[Jhn.3.4; 21.16|Jhn.3:4 21:16]], [[1Co.12.28|1Co.12:28]], [[Rev.19.3|Rev.19:3]]; τὸ δ., [[2Co.13.2|2Co.13:2]], [[Jude.5|Ju 5]]; ἐν τ. δ., **at the second time**: [[Act.7.13|Act.7:13]] in later usage (as [[1Ma.9.1|1Ma.9:1]]), ἐκ δ., [[Mrk.14.72|Mrk.14:72]], [[Jhn.9.24|Jhn.9:24]], [[Act.11.9|Act.11:9]], [[Heb.9.28|Heb.9:28]].
(AS)

G1287.def:
**δια-σκορπίζω **
[in LXX for פּוּץ, זָרָה, etc. ;]
**to scatter abroad, disperse**: of sheep, [[Mat.26.31|Mat.26:31]] = [[Mrk.14.27|Mrk.14:27]]" (LXX) ; of persons, [[Luk.1.51|Luk.1:51]], [[Act.5.37|Act.5:37]], opposite to συνάγω, [[Jhn.11.52|Jhn.11:52]] of winnowing grain, [[Mat.25.24, 26|Mat.25:24, 26]]; metaphorically, of property, **to squander, waste**: [[Luk.15.13; 16.1|Luk.15:13 16:1]].†
(AS)

G1242.def:
**διαθήκη**, -ης, ἡ
(διατίθημι), [frequently in LXX, and nearly always for בְּרִית ;]
1. as usually in cl., **a disposition, testament, will** (Plat., al.): [[Gal.3.15|Gal.3:15]] (R, mg., but see Lft., in l.), [[Heb.9.16, 17|Heb.9:16, 17]] (R, txt.; MM, _Exp._, xi; Milligan, _NTD_, 75; Abbott, _Essays_, 107; Deiss., _LAE_, 341; but see infr.).
2. As in LXX (for בְּרִית) = cl. συνθήκη, **a convention, arrangement, covenant** (exc. in the disputed cases mentioned above, always between God and man, "perhaps with the feeling that the δια- compound was more suitable than the συν- for a covenant with God---συνθ. might suggest equal terms," MM, _Exp._, l.with): [[Gal.3.15|Gal.3:15]] (R, txt., but see supr., and cf. Thayer, see word), [[Heb.9.16, 17|Heb.9:16, 17]] (R, mg., Westc., in l.; Hatch, _Essays_, 47; but see supr.), [[Mat.26.28|Mat.26:28]], [[Mrk.14.24|Mrk.14:24]], [[Luk.1.72|Luk.1:72]], [[Act.3.25; 7.8|Act.3:25 7:8]], [[Rom.11.27|Rom.11:27]]" (LXX), [[2Co.3.14|2Co.3:14]], [[Gal.3.17|Gal.3:17]], [[Heb.7.22; 8.6|Heb.7:22 8:6]], ib. 9, 10" (LXX) 9:4, 15-17 20" (LXX) 10:16 (LXX), 29 12:24 13:20, [[Rev.11.19|Rev.11:19]]; καινὴ δ., [[Mat.26.28|Mat.26:28]], and [[Mrk.14.24|Mrk.14:24]] (R, mg.), [[Luk.22.20|Luk.22:20]], [[1Co.11.25|1Co.11:25]], [[2Co.3.6|2Co.3:6]], [[Heb.8.8|Heb.8:8]]" (LXX) 9:15; pl. [[Rom.9.4|Rom.9:4]], [[Gal.4.24|Gal.4:24]], [[Eph.2.12|Eph.2:12]].†
(AS)

G1284.def:
**δια-ρήσσω** (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω
(poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
**to break asunder**, **burst**, **rend**: δεσμά, [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]] pass., δίκτυα, [[Luk.5.6|Luk.5:6]] ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as [[Gen.37.29|Gen.37:29]], al.), [[Mat.26.65|Mat.26:65]], [[Act.14.14|Act.14:14]], [[Mrk.14.63|Mrk.14:63]].†
(AS)

G1212.def:
**δῆλος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX for אוּר, etc. ;]
1. **visible**.
2. **clear** to the mind, **evident**: [[Mat.26.73|Mat.26:73]] δ. (sc. ἐστίν), before ὅτι, [[1Co.15.27|1Co.15:27]], [[Gal.3.11|Gal.3:11]].†
_SYN._: φανερός, with ref. to outward appearance, _manifest_ as opposite to concealed; δ. with ref. to inner perception, **evident**, known, under­stood. (AS)

G1266.def:
**δια-μερίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for חלק pi. ;]
1. **to distribute**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.2.45|Act.2:45]] before εἰς, [[Luk.22.17|Luk.22:17]], pass., [[Act.2.3|Act.2:3]] Mid. **to distribute among themselves**: [[Mat.27.35|Mat.27:35]], [[Mrk.15.24|Mrk.15:24]], [[Luk.23.34|Luk.23:34]]; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, [[Jhn.19.24|Jhn.19:24]] (LXX) (see M, _Pr._, 157).
2. **to divide, separate**: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Luk.11.17-18;|Luk.11:17-18]] ἐπί, with dative, [[Luk.12.52-53|Luk.12:52-53]]†
(AS)

G1288.def:
**δια-σπάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַק, as [[Jdg.16.9|Jdg.16:9]] ;]
**to break** or **tear asunder**: pass., ἁλύσεις, [[Mrk.5.4|Mrk.5:4]] Παῦλος, [[Act.23.10|Act.23:10]]†
(AS)

G1272.def:
**δι-αν-οίγω **
[in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc. ;]
**to open up completely, to open**: [[Luk.2.23|Luk.2:23]] (LXX); pass., [[Mrk.7.34|Mrk.7:34]], [[Act.7.56|Act.7:56]]. Metaphorical, δ. τ. νοῦν, [[Luk.24.45|Luk.24:45]], τ. καρδίαν, [[Act.16.14|Act.16:14]], pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, [[Luk.24.31|Luk.24:31]] of explaining, τ. γραφάς, [[Luk.24.32|Luk.24:32]], [[Act.17.3|Act.17:3]].†
(AS)

G1256.def:
**δια-λέγομαι**
(mid. of διαλέγω, **to pick out, distinguish**, as depon.), [in LXX: [[Exo.6.27|Exo.6:27]], [[Isa.63.1|Isa.63:1]] (דּבר pi.), [[Jdg.8.1|Jdg.8:1]] (ריב), [[1Es.8.46|1Es.8:46]], [[Est.5.2|Est.5:2]], [[Sir.14.20|Sir.14:20]], [[2Ma.11.20|2Ma.11:20]] * ;]
**to converse with, discourse** (see _Cl. Rev._, i, 45), **discuss, argue**: [[Act.18.4; 19.8,9; 20.9|Act.18:4 19:8,9 20:9]]; with dative of person(s), [[Act.17.17; 18.19; 20.7|Act.17:17 18:19 20:7]], [[Heb.12.5|Heb.12:5]]; before πρός, [[Mrk.9.34|Mrk.9:34]], [[Act.17.17; 24.12|Act.17:17 24:12]]; περί [[Act.24.25|Act.24:25]], [[Jude.9|Ju 9]]; ἀπὸ τ. γραφῶν, [[Act.17.2|Act.17:2]]†
(AS)

G1230.def:
**δια-γίνομαι**
(Ion. and late Gk. for διαγίγν-), [in LXX, [[2Ma.11.26|2Ma.11:26]] * ;]
1. **to go through, to pass**, e.g. τ. νύκτα; absol., **to live**.
2. Of time, **to intervene, elapse**: ptcp., with ἡμερῶν τινῶν, [[Act.25.13|Act.25:13]] ἱκανοῦ χρόνου, [[Act.27.9|ib. 27:9]]; τ. σαβάτου, [[Mrk.16.1|Mrk.16:1]]†
(AS)

G1269.def:
**δια-νεύω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.35.19|Ps 34(35):19]] (קרץ), [[Sir.27.22|Sir.27:22]] * ;]
**to wink at, nod to, beckon to**: [[Luk.1.22|Luk.1:22]]†
(AS)

G1265.def:
**δια-μένω **
[in LXX for עמד, etc.;]
**to remain, continue**: [[Luk.1.22; 22.28|Luk.1:22 22:28]], [[Gal.2.5|Gal.2:5]], [[Heb.1.11|Heb.1:11]]" (LXX), [[2Pe.3.4|2Pe.3:4]]†
(AS)

G1255.def:
**δια-λαλέω**, -ῶ
[in Sm.: [[Psa.51.16|Ps 50(51):16]], and al. ;]
1. **to talk with**: πρός, [[Luk.6.11|Luk.6:11]]
2. **to talk over**: pass., [[Luk.1.65|Luk.1:65]]†
(AS)

G1203.def:
**δεσπότης**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אָדוֹן, אֲדֹנָי; in [[Jdt.9.17|Jdth.9:17]], δ. τ. οὐρανῶν κ. τ. γῆς];
**a master, lord**, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: [[1Ti.6.1|1Ti.6:1]], 2, [[2Ti.2.21|2Ti.2:21]], [[Tit.2.9|Tit.2:9]], [[1Pe.2.18|1Pe.2:18]]; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), [[Luk.2.29|Luk.2:29]], [[Act.4.24|Act.4:24]]; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), [[Rev.6.10|Rev.6:10]] of Christ, [[2Pe.2.1|2Pe.2:1]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]], R, txt. (but cf. mg.).†
_SYN._: κύριος (which see), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer). (AS)

G1286.def:
**δια-σείω **
[in LXX: [[Job.4.14|Job.4:14]] (פָּחַד hi.), [[3Ma.7.21|3Ma.7:21]] * ;]
**to shake violently**; metaphorically, **to intimidate**: [[Luk.3.14|Luk.3:14]]†
(AS)

G1279.def:
**δια-πορεύω **
[in LXX for עָבַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
**to carry over**. Pass., **to pass across, journey through**: absol., [[Luk.18.36|Luk.18:36]], [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]]; before κατὰ πόλεις κ. κώμας, [[Luk.13.22|Luk.13:22]] διά, with genitive, [[Mrk.2.23|Mrk.2:23]], [[Luk.6.1|Luk.6:1]] (cf. [[Pro.9.12|Pro.9:12]] with, [[Wis.3.1|Wis.3:1]]); with accusative, [[Act.16.4|Act.16:4]]†
(AS)

G1273.def:
**δια-νυκτερεύω**
(cf. διημερεύω, _to pass the day_) [in LXX: [[Job.2.9|Job.2:9]] * ;]
**to pass the night**: before ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, [[Luk.6.12|Luk.6:12]]†
(AS)

G1257.def:
**δια-λείπω **
[in LXX for יחל (as [[1Sa.10.8|1Ki.10:8]]), etc. ;]
**to intermit, leave off** for a time: [[Luk.7.45|Luk.7:45]]†
(AS)

G1280.def:
**δι-απορέω**, -ῶ
[in Sm.: [[Psa.77.5|Psa.77:5]], [[Dan.2.1|Dan.2:1]] * ;]
**to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity**: absol., [[Act.2.12|Act.2:12]] before διὰ τό, with inf., [[Luk.9.7|Luk.9:7]] περί, [[Act.5.24|Act.5:24]] ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[Act.10.17|Act.10:17]]†
(AS)

G1235.def:
**δια-γρηγορέω**, -ῶ
(a) prop., **to remain awake** (R, mg.);
(b) **to be fully awake** (R, txt.): [[Luk.9.32|Luk.9:32]]†
(AS)

G1229.def:
**δι-αγγέλω **
[in LXX for ספר pi., etc. ;]
**to publish abroad, proclaim**: with accusative, [[Luk.9.60|Luk.9:60]], [[Act.21.26|Act.21:26]], [[Rom.9.17|Rom.9:17]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1248.def:
**διακονία**, -ας, ἡ
(διάκονος), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: [[Est.6.3|Est.6:3]], [[Est.6.5|Est.6:5]] A; [[1Ma.11.58|1Ma.11:58]] * ;]
**the office and work of a διάκονος, service, ministry**;
(a) **of domestic duties **(Field, _Notes_, 63): [[Luk.10.40|Luk.10:40]]
(b) spec. of religious ministration, and the exercise of ministerial functions in the Church: [[Act.1.17, 25; 6.1, 4; 11.29; 12.25; 20.24; 21.19|Act.1:17, 25 6:1, 4 11:29 12:25 20:24; 21:19]], [[Rom.11.13; 12.7; 15.31|Rom.11:13 12:7 15:31]], [[1Co.16.15|1Co.16:15]], [[2Co.4.1; 6.3; 8.4; 9.1, 13|2Co.4:1 6:3 8:4 9:1, 13]], [[Eph.4.12|Eph.4:12]], [[Col.4.17|Col.4:17]], [[1Ti.1.12|1Ti.1:12]], [[2Ti.4.5, 11|2Ti.4:5, 11]], [[Heb.1.14|Heb.1:14]], [[Rev.2.19|Rev.2:19]]; δ. τ. θανάτου, [[2Co.3.7|2Co.3:7]] τ. πνεύματος, [[2Co.3.8|2Co. 3:8]]; τ. κατακρίσεως, τ, δικαιοσύνης, [[2Co.3.9|2Co. 3:9]]; τ. καταλλαγῆς, [[2Co.5.18|2Co. 5:18]]; τ. λειτουργίας, [[2Co.9.12|2Co. 9:12]]; with obj. genitive, τὴν ὑμῶν δ., [[2Co.11.8|ib. 11:8]]; pl., [[1Co.12.5|1Co.12:5]]†
(AS)

G1270.def:
**δια-νόημα**, -τος, τό
(διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., [[Isa.55.9|Isa.55:9]], al., frequently in Sir ;]
**a thought**: [[Luk.11.17|Luk.11:17]]†
(AS)

G1239.def:
**δια-διδωμι **
[in LXX for חלק pi., etc. ;]
1. **to hand over, deliver**: [[Rev.17.13|Rev.17:13]], Rec.
2. **to distribute**: [[Luk.11.22; 18.22|Luk.11:22 18:22]], [[Jhn.6.11|Jhn.6:11]], [[Act.4.35|Act.4:35]]†
(AS)

G1267.def:
**δια-μερισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαμερίζω), [in LXX: [[Ezk.48.29|Eze.48:29]] (מַחֲלֹקֶת), [[Mic.7.12|Mic.7:12]] * ;]
**a division**: opposite to εἰρήνη, [[Luk.12.51|Luk.12:51]]†
(AS)

G1234.def:
**δια-γογγύζω **
[in LXX chiefly for לין, לון, as [[Exo.16.2|Exo.16:2]], and cf. Si 34(31):24 ;]
of a number, **to murmur** or **mutter among themselves**: [[Luk.15.2; 19.7|Luk.15:2 19:7]].†
(AS)

G1244.def:
**δι-αιρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for בּתר (as [[Gen.15.10|Gen.15:10]]), חלק (as [[Jos.18.5|Jos.18:5]]), etc. ;]
1. **to divide into parts, cut asunder**.
2. **to distribute**: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), [[Luk.15.12|Luk.15:12]], [[1Co.12.11|1Co.12:11]].†
(AS)

G1225.def:
**δια-βάλλω **
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:8, [[Dan.3.8; 6.24|Da TH 3:8; 6:24]] (25) (אֲכַל קְרַץ), [[2Ma.3.11|2Ma.3:11]], [[4Ma.4.1|4Ma.4:1]] * ;]
1. **to throw across**.
2. **To slander, defame, accuse falsely** or **maliciously**: [[Luk.16.1|Luk.16:1]] (Cremer, 120).†
(AS)

G1224.def:
**δια-βαίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for עבר ;]
1. **to make a stride**.
2. **to step across, cross over**;
(a) trans.: τ. θάλασσαι, [[Heb.11.29|Heb.11:29]]
(b) intrans.: before εἰς, [[Act.16.9|Act.16:9]] πρός, [[Luk.16.26|Luk.16:26]]†
(AS)

G1263.def:
**δια-μαρτύρομαι**, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see,
[in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), [[Deu.4.26; 8.19|Deu.4:26 8:19]], [[1Sa.8.9|1Ki.8:9]], al. ;]
**solemnly to protest**: [[Luk.16.28|Luk.16:28]], [[Act.2.40; 8.25; 10.42; 18.5; 20.21, 23, 24; 23.11; 28.23|Act.2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23]], [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]], [[Heb.2.6|Heb.2:6]]; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[1Ti.5.21|1Ti.5:21]], [[2Ti.2.14; 4.1|2Ti.2:14 4:1]] (Cremer, 415).†
(AS)

G1281.def:
**δια-πραγματεύομαι **, "perfective compound" (see M, _Pr._, 118);
1. **to examine thoroughly** (Plat.).
2. In late writers (Dion. Hal.), **to gain by trading**: [[Luk.19.15|Luk.19:15]]†
(AS)

G1290.def:
**δια-σπορά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(διασπείρω), [in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as [[Deu.28.25|Deu.28:25]] (זַעֲוָה) [[Deu.30.4|Deu.30:4]] (נָדַח ni.), [[Isa.49.6|Isa.49:6]] (נער); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as [[Psa.147.2|Psa.147:2]], [[2Ma.1.27|2Ma.1:27]]) ;]
**a dispersion**: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, [[Jhn.7.35|Jhn.7:35]] metaphorically, of Christians (_DB_, iii, 782 f.), [[Jas.1.1|Jas.1:1]], [[1Pe.1.1|1Pe.1:1]] (see Hort, in ll).†
(AS)

G1241.def:
**δια-ζώννυμι**, (also -ννύω)
[in LXX for חֲגוֹר, [[Ezk.23.15|Eze.23:15]] A * ;]
**to gird round**: ἑαυτόν, [[Jhn.13.4|Jhn.13:4]] pass., [[Jhn.13.5|ib. 13:5]]; mid., **to gird oneself with**: with accusative, [[Jhn.21.7|Jhn.21:7]]†
(AS)

G1258.def:
**διά-λεκτος**, -ου, ἡ
(διαλέγομαι), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:4 (לָשׁוֹן), [[Est.9.26|Est.9:26]] * ;]
1. **conversation, discourse, speech** (Plat., Dem., al.).
2. As in Polyb. and later writers, the **language** or **dialect** of a particular country or district: [[Act.1.19; 2.6, 8; 21.40; 22.2; 26.14|Act.1:19 2:6, 8 21:40 22:2 26:14]].†
(AS)

G1278.def:
**δια-πονέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Ecc.10.9|Ecc.10:9]] (עָצַב ni.), [[2Ma.2.28|2Ma.2:28]] in Aq.: [[Gen.6.6|Gen.6:6]], [[1Sa.20.3|1Ki.20:3]] * ;]
**to work out with labour**. Pass., **to be worn out, sore troubled**: [[Mrk.14.4|Mrk.14:4]] (WH, mg.), [[Act.4.2; 16.18|Act.4:2 16:18]].†
(AS)

G1268.def:
**δια-νέμω **
[in LXX for חלק, [[Deu.29.25|Deu.29:25]] * ;]
**to distribute, divide**: pass., **to be spread about**, [[Act.4.17|Act.4:17]]†
(AS)

G1292.def:
**διάστημα**, -τος, τό
(διίστημι), [in LXX for רֶוַח, etc. ;]
**an interval, space**: of time (Sir, prol. 24), [[Act.5.7|Act.5:7]]†
(AS)

G1282.def:
**δια-πρίω **
[in LXX: [[1Ch.20.3|1Ch.20:3]] (סוּר) * ;]
**to saw asunder**. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, **cut to the heart**: [[Act.5.33|Act.5:33]] before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, [[Act.7.54|Act.7:54]]†
(AS)

G1262.def:
**δια-λύω **
[in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;]
**to part asunder, dissolve**; of an assembly, pass., **to disperse**: [[Act.5.36|Act.5:36]]†
(AS)

G1237.def:
**δια-δέχομαι **
[in LXX for מִשְׁנֶה (Deiss., _BS_, 115), פַּרְבָּר ;]
**to receive through another, receive in turn**: [[Act.7.45|Act.7:45]] (RV, _in their turn_; see Field, _Notes_, 116).†
(AS)

G1296.def:
**δια-ταγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(διατάσσω), [in LXX: [[Est.4.11|Est.4:11]] (פַּרְשֶׁגֶן)* ;]
in late writers (Deiss., _LAE_, 86 ff.) for cl. διάταξις (WH., however, is found in LXX, [[Psa.119.91|Psa.119:91]], al.);
(a) **disposition** (cf. διάταξις for צָבָא; Sm., [[4Ki.23.4|4Ki.23:4]], [[Jer.8.2; 19.13|Jer.8:2 19:13]]); εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων, AV, by the disposition of angels (Alf., in l, Field, _Notes_, 116; but see infr.): [[Act.7.53|Act.7:53]]
(b) **ordinance** (C. I. 3465): [[Rom.13.2|Rom.13:2]], [[Act.7.53|Act.7:53]], R, txt. (and see mg.; Page and EGT, in l; but also see supr.).†
(AS)

G1289.def:
**δια-σπείρω **
[frequently in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;]
**to scatter abroad, disperse**: [[Act.8.1, 4; 11.19|Act.8:1, 4 11:19]].†
(AS)

G1215.def:
**δημηγορέω**, -ῶ
(δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, _to speak in the assembly_), [in LXX: [[Pro.24.66|Pro.24:66]] (30:31), [[4Ma.5.15|4Ma.5:15]] * ;]
**to deliver an oration**: [[Act.12.21|Act.12:21]]†
(AS)

G1218.def:
**δῆμος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1. **a district**, **country**.
2. **the common people**, **the people** generally; esp. **the people assembled**: [[Act.12.22; 17.5; 19.30, 33|Act.12:22 17:5 19:30 33]].
† _SYN._: λαός, **the people at large**: δ., the people as a body politic; opposite to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized _multitude_. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, _a nation_, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: _Gentiles_. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is frequently in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. _Cl. Rev._, i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689). (AS)

G1216.def:
**Δημήτριος**, -ου, ὁ
**Demetrius**;
1. a silversmith, [[Act.19.24, 38|Act.19:24 38]].
2. A Christian disciple, [[3Jn.12|III Jn 12]].†
(AS)

G1274.def:
**δι-ανύω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.12.17|2Ma.12:17]] * ;]
1. **to accomplish fully, finish, complete**: [[Act.21.7|Act.21:7]] (EV).
2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), **to continue**: Ac, l.with (Field, _Notes_, 134f.).†
(AS)

G1264.def:
**δια-μάχομαι **
[in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; [[Sir.8.1, 3; 38.28; 51.19|Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19]] * ;]
1. **to struggle against**.
2. In argument, **to contend**: [[Act.23.9|Act.23:9]]†
(AS)

G1231.def:
**δια-γινώσκω**
(see previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. [[2Ma.9.15|2Ma.9:15]] ;]
1. **to distinguish, ascertain exactly**: [[Act.23.15|Act.23:15]]
2. As Athen. law-term, **to determine**: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, [[Act.24.22|Act.24:22]] (Cremer, 673).†
(AS)

G1251.def:
**δι-ακούω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.1.16|Deu.1:16]] (שׁמע), [[Job.9.33|Job.9:33]] (יָד שִׁית hi.)* ;]
**to hear through, hear fully**; technically, **to hear judicially** (as De, l.with; of. Deiss., _BS_, 230): [[Act.23.35|Act.23:35]]†
(AS)

G1240.def:
**διά-δοχος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(διαδέχομαι), [in LXX: [[1Ch.18.17|1Ch.18:17]] (לְיַד), [[2Ch.26.11|2Ch.26:11]] (שַׂר) 28:7 (מִשְׁנֶה), [[Sir.46.1; 48.8|Sir.46:1 48:8]], [[2Ma.4.29; 14.26|2Ma.4:29 14:26]] * ;]
**a successor**: [[Act.24.27|Act.24:27]] (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., _BS_, 115).†
(AS)

G1233.def:
**διά-γνωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: [[Wis.3.18|Wis.3:18]] * ;]
1. **a distinguishing**, also as medical term.
2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), **determination, decision**: [[Act.25.21|Act.25:21]] (Cremer, 674).†
(AS)

G1202.def:
**δεσμώτης**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for אסר, מַסְגֵּר ;]
**a prisoner**: [[Act.27.1, 42|Act.27:1, 42]].†
(AS)

G1277.def: **to sail across **, Thuc.; εἰς Αἴγιναν (Aristophanes Comicus): _metaphorically_, δ. βίον **to make ** life's **voyage **, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1206.def:
**δευτεραῖος**, -α, -ον
(δεύτερος),
_adj._ with adverbial sense;
**on the second day**: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, [[Act.28.13|Act.28:13]]†
(AS)

G1293.def:
**δια-στολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(διαστέλλω), [in LXX for פְּדוּת: [[Exo.8.23|Exo.8:23]], etc. ;]
1. **a separation**.
2. **a distinction, difference**: [[Rom.3.22; 10.12|Rom.3:22 10:12]], [[1Co.14.7|1Co.14:7]].†
(AS)

G1253.def:
**διά-κρισις**, -εως, ἡ
(διακρίνω) [in LXX for מִפְלָשׂ, [[Job.37.16|Job.37:16]] * ;]
the act of **judgment, discernment**: [[Rom.14.1|Rom.14:1]], [[1Co.12.10|1Co.12:10]], [[Heb.5.14|Heb.5:14]].†
(AS)

G1213.def:
**δηλόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;]
**to make plain, declare**: with accusative, [[1Co.3.13|1Co.3:13]], [[Col.1.8|Col.1:8]], [[Heb.9.8; 12.27|Heb.9:8 12:27]]; with dative of person(s), [[2Pe.1.14|2Pe.1:14]] with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), [[1Co.1.11|1Co.1:11]] before εἰς, [[1Pe.1.11|1Pe.1:11]]†
_SYN._: ἐμφανίζω, _to make manifest_, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind. (AS)

G1243.def:
**δι-αίρεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(διαιρέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
1. **a distinction, diference**.
2. **a division, distribution**: [[1Co.12.4-6|1Co.12:4-6]] (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).†
(AS)

G1214.def:
**Δημᾶς**, ὁ
(perh. contracted from Δημήτριος),
**Demas**, a companion of St. Paul: [[Col.4.14|Col.4:14]], Phm 24, [[2Ti.4.10|2Ti.4:10]].†
(AS)

G1236.def:
**δι-άγω **
[in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;]
1. **to carry over**.
2. Of time, **to pass**: βίον, [[1Ti.2.2|1Ti.2:2]] absol., **to live**, before ἐν, [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]]†
(AS)

G1217.def:
**δημιουργός**, -οῦ, ὑ
(δῆμος, ἔργον), [in LXX: [[2Ma.4.1|2Ma.4:1]] * ;]
1. **one who works for the people**.
2. Univ., **an author, builder, maker**; **the maker** of the world (Xen., _Mem._, I, 4, 9, al.), [[Heb.11.10|Heb.11:10]]†
_SYN._: κτίστης, _creator_, τεχνίτης, _craftsman, designer_. In He, l.with, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution. (AS)

G1238.def:
**διάδημα**, -τος, τό
(διαδέω, _to bind round_), [in LXX for כֶּתֶר (as [[Est.1.11|Est.1:11]]), etc. ;]
the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; **a diadem**, the badge of royalty: [[Rev.12.3; 13.1; 19.12|Rev.12:3 13:1 19:12]].†
_SYN._: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, _Th._, i, 219; cf. _DB_, i, 530, 604). (AS)
